description: Recruiter-led resume refinement and career-value discovery from TRX Search.

defaultPrompt: What does my résumé say about me, and what do you need to know before recommending changes?
Compare my résumé with this job and show where my fit is strong, unclear, or missing.
I’m not getting the traction I want. Help me see what my résumé is signaling and what I should emphasize instead.
interface.longDescription: See what your résumé currently communicates, uncover career evidence you may be overlooking, sharpen positioning, and improve clarity for human, ATS, and AI-assisted review. Full redrafts are available only when requested.

name: trx-search-resume-refiner
